glosses.notes: Used when a formal event, exhibition, or festival officially begins.

examples.sentence: 这个展览下周正式开幕。
这个展览已经开幕了。
开幕后，很多人进来参观。

example_translations.translation: This exhibition officially opens next week.
This exhibition has already opened.
After it officially opened, many people came in to look around.

glosses.notes: The formal ceremony held at the beginning of an event or exhibition.

examples.sentence: 我们九点去看开幕式。
开幕式还没开始，门口已经有很多人了。
校长在开幕式上讲了很短的话。

example_translations.translation: We are going to watch the opening ceremony at nine.
The opening ceremony has not started yet, but there are already many people at the entrance.
The principal gave a short speech at the opening ceremony.

glosses.notes: Water that has been boiled. In everyday use it often refers to hot boiled water for drinking.

examples.sentence: 医生让我多喝开水。
这杯开水太热了。
外面很冷，先喝点开水吧。

example_translations.translation: The doctor told me to drink more boiled water.
This cup of boiled water is too hot.
It is cold outside, so have some boiled water first.

glosses.primary_gloss: to open a service or line
glosses.notes: Used for opening a line, route, service, or account so that it can officially be used.

examples.sentence: 这条地铁线下个月开通。
银行短信服务今天开通了。

examples.meaning_en: to open a service or line
examples.sentence: 新网站刚开通，很多人在看。

example_translations.translation: This subway line will open next month.
The bank's text message service was activated today.
The new website just went live, and many people are looking at it.

glosses.notes: Used when a shop, restaurant, company, or other business starts operating.

examples.sentence: 这家书店今天正式开业。
饭店还没开业，门口就有人等了。
新店开业以后，生意一直很好。

example_translations.translation: This bookstore officially opened for business today.
The restaurant had not opened yet, but people were already waiting at the door.
Business has been very good since the new shop opened.

glosses.notes: Often used for formally carrying out work, activities, projects, or new areas of business.

examples.sentence: 学校这周要开展安全教育活动。
会议结束以后，大家马上开展工作。
新业务刚开展，还需要一点时间。

example_translations.translation: The school will carry out a safety education activity this week.
As soon as the meeting ended, everyone got to work right away.
The new business has only just gotten underway, so it still needs a little time.

glosses.notes: Read kān here, not kàn. It means keeping an eye on a person, place, or thing so it stays safe.

examples.sentence: 你先帮我看一下行李。
我去买水，你帮我看孩子吧。
白天没人看门，晚上才有人来。

example_translations.translation: Please help me watch my luggage for a moment first.
I am going to buy water, so please watch the child for me.
No one watches the door during the day, and people only come at night.

glosses.notes: Used for visiting someone, especially a relative, teacher, older person, or patient.

examples.sentence: 周末我们去医院看望老师。
我想先去看望外婆，再回家。
她带着水果去看望病人。

example_translations.translation: We are going to the hospital to visit the teacher this weekend.
I want to visit my grandmother first and then go home.
She took some fruit to visit the patient.

glosses.notes: Used when treating or understanding something as a certain kind of thing.

examples.sentence: 我一直把他看作朋友。
不要把这件事看作小问题。
老师把失败看作学习的一部分。

example_translations.translation: I have always regarded him as a friend.
Do not see this matter as a small problem.
The teacher regards failure as part of learning.

glosses.notes: Can mean physically leaning against something, depending on someone or something, or being near a place.

examples.sentence: 他累了，就靠在墙上休息。
小孩子不能总靠父母。
我家靠学校，所以很方便。

example_translations.translation: He was tired, so he leaned against the wall to rest.
Children cannot always rely on their parents.
My home is close to the school, so it is very convenient.

glosses.notes: Used when moving nearer to a person, place, or object.

examples.sentence: 请不要靠近机器。
火车已经慢慢靠近车站了。
他一听见声音就靠近门口。

example_translations.translation: Please do not go near the machine.
The train has already slowly approached the station.
As soon as he heard a sound, he moved closer to the doorway.

glosses.primary_gloss: measure word for small round objects
glosses.notes: Used for small round things such as stars, candies, teeth, and similar objects.

examples.meaning_en: measure word for small round objects
examples.sentence: 我吃了一颗糖。

examples.meaning_en: measure word for small round objects
examples.sentence: 天上有一颗很亮的星星。

examples.meaning_en: measure word for small round objects
examples.sentence: 我又吃了一颗葡萄。

example_translations.translation: I ate a piece of candy.
There is a very bright star in the sky.
I ate another grape.

glosses.notes: Usually a noun meaning scientific research. It often appears in phrases like 做科研 or 搞科研.

examples.sentence: 他毕业以后想做科研。
这所大学很重视科研。
爸爸一直在科研单位工作。

example_translations.translation: He wants to do scientific research after graduation.
This university attaches great importance to scientific research.
My father has always worked at a scientific research institute.

glosses.notes: Used to draw a conclusion from what has just been said or seen, similar to 'so it is clear that...'.

examples.sentence: 大家都同意，可见这个办法不错。
他准备得这么认真，可见他很重视。
她学了半年就能上台，可见她很努力。

example_translations.translation: Everyone agrees, so it is clear that this method is good.
He prepared this seriously, so it is clear that he really cares about it.
She was able to go on stage after only half a year of study, so it is clear that she worked very hard.

glosses.notes: Describes a person, method, or piece of information that can be trusted.

examples.sentence: 他做事认真，很可靠。
这个消息可靠吗？
她终于找到了一个可靠的办法。

example_translations.translation: He works seriously and is very reliable.
Is this news reliable?
She finally found a dependable method.

glosses.notes: Describes something that causes fear or feels very serious in a bad way.

examples.sentence: 半夜突然停电，真的有点可怕。
最可怕的是他什么都没说。
病不可怕，可怕的是不去看医生。

example_translations.translation: The power suddenly went out in the middle of the night, which was really a little frightening.
The most terrible thing was that he did not say anything at all.
Being sick is not the frightening part; the frightening part is not going to see a doctor.

glosses.notes: Used for overcoming a difficulty, weakness, fear, or problem.

examples.sentence: 我们一定能克服这个困难。
她花了很长时间才克服紧张。
公司正在想办法克服这个问题。

example_translations.translation: We will definitely be able to overcome this difficulty.
It took her a long time to overcome her nervousness.
The company is trying to find a way to overcome this problem.

glosses.notes: Usually a noun referring to customer service staff or the customer service department.

examples.sentence: 你先问一下客服吧。
客服已经把问题记下来了。
我给客服打了三个电话。

example_translations.translation: Ask customer service first.
Customer service has already written the problem down.
I made three phone calls to customer support.

glosses.notes: Describes a fair view based on facts rather than personal feelings alone.

examples.sentence: 你要客观一点，不要只怪别人。
老师的分析很客观。
我们应该更客观地看这个问题。

example_translations.translation: You need to be more objective and not blame only other people.
The teacher's analysis is very objective.
We should look at this problem more objectively.

glosses.notes: Used for a business customer or client, especially in companies and sales contexts.

examples.sentence: 这家公司有很多老客户。
客服已经联系了那位客户。
客户对这个结果很满意。

example_translations.translation: This company has many longtime clients.
Customer service has already contacted that client.
The client is very satisfied with this result.

glosses.notes: Can mean physical space, or room left for development, change, or improvement.

examples.sentence: 这个房间空间不大，但是很干净。
桌子下面还有一点空间。
这个计划还有改进的空间。

example_translations.translation: This room does not have much space, but it is very clean.
There is still a little space under the table.
There is still room to improve this plan.

glosses.notes: Refers to the air or sky above the ground. It can describe things that happen or exist there.

examples.sentence: 一只鸟从空中飞过。
空中的星星很亮。
飞机正在空中飞行。

example_translations.translation: A bird flew past in the air.
The stars in the sky are very bright.
The plane is flying in the air.

glosses.notes: Used for controlling a situation, illness, sound, emotion, or some other process.

examples.sentence: 请控制自己的声音。
医生说要先控制病情。
他努力控制自己的情绪。

example_translations.translation: Please control your voice.
The doctor said the condition needs to be controlled first.
He tried hard to control his emotions.

glosses.notes: The pocket in clothing or a small bag-like place for holding things.

examples.sentence: 他从口袋里拿出一把钥匙。
我的口袋里还有十块钱。
这个衣服没有口袋。

example_translations.translation: He took a key out of his pocket.
I still have ten yuan in my pocket.
This piece of clothing does not have pockets.

glosses.notes: Can mean the flavor of food, and by extension someone's food preference.

examples.sentence: 这家店的口味比较淡。
南方人和北方人口味不太一样。
这道菜太甜了，不合我的口味。

example_translations.translation: The flavors at this restaurant are on the mild side.
People in the south and north do not have quite the same tastes.
This dish is too sweet and does not suit my taste.

glosses.notes: A storage place or warehouse. As a single character, it often appears inside compounds, but it can still refer to storage space on its own.

examples.sentence: 货都已经放进库里了。
这个库很大，能放很多东西。
工人正在库里整理货。

example_translations.translation: The goods have all already been put into the warehouse.
This warehouse is large and can hold a lot of things.
The workers are sorting the goods in the storage area.

glosses.notes: Kept here on the common adjective sense. It can describe roads, spaces, clothes, or other things with a lot of width.

examples.sentence: 这条路比以前宽多了。
这件衣服有点宽。
桌子太宽，进不了门。

example_translations.translation: This road is much wider than before.
This piece of clothing is a little loose.
The table is too wide to fit through the door.

glosses.notes: The measurement of how wide something is.

examples.sentence: 这张桌子的宽度正好。
请先量一下门的宽度。
这座桥的宽度不一样。

example_translations.translation: The width of this table is just right.
Please measure the width of the door first.
The width of this bridge is not uniform.

glosses.notes: Kept on the loss sense here: losing money or coming out behind in a deal or sale.

examples.sentence: 这笔生意让公司亏了很多钱。
这么卖的话，我们太亏了。
要是现在卖掉，你就亏了。

example_translations.translation: This deal made the company lose a lot of money.
If we sell it at this price, we will be taking too much of a loss.
If you sell it now, you will take a loss.

glosses.notes: A general word for insects.

examples.sentence: 夏天晚上总有很多昆虫。
有些昆虫会飞，有些不会。
孩子们在花园里看昆虫。

example_translations.translation: There are always many insects on summer nights.
Some insects can fly, and some cannot.
The children are looking at insects in the garden.
